Name: SoundLoop Mod
Author: strelkasaur
Description:
A small mod that makes the in-game music loop, making the game a bit less silent. This is especially helpful for people who use TimeSpeed.

The mod integrates with the game's built-in music code, improving compatibility and keeping the same "feel" as the vanilla game, while filling some of the excessive silence.
However, there are a few caveats to bear in mind:

[list]
[*]The music will go silent after dark (6-8pm depending on season).
[*]There may be a short pause between each loop.
[*]Music will not loop unless you are outdoors or in the mines.
[*]The Pelican Town song will play less often, since the game's conditions to start this song (entering the town while no current song playing) are less likely to be met.
[/list]

Some of these limitations might be fixed in later versions.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows. Should work on earlier and later releases as well.
[*]Linux/macOS: if you get an error loading the mod in the SMAPI console, make sure that at least read permissions are set on the files (chmod 644 or right click on files > properties/get info > permissions...). This is caused by some issue with my SMAPI build setup, I'll try to get the bottom of this and fix the file soon.
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Fixes the following issues:
- Default music starts playing while on the bus travelling to the desert.
- Default music sometimes plays in the secret woods

Thanks to everyone who gave feedback to help find these issues.
